title: Cloning a `subGauge` can result in an uninitialized proxy
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as `subGauge` initialization can be front-ran  **Likelihood:** High, as every new `subGauge` will be vulnerable  ## Description  In `GaugeFactory::createSubGauge`, the `Clones::cloneDeterministic` method is used to deploy a new `subGauge`. The problem is, in contrast to `GaugeFactory::createGaugeProxyAndSubGauges`, in `createSubGauge` the `subGauge` is not initialized after cloning, which leaves it vulnerable to a front-running attack.
